fact: A hot blue star of the Archer — and one of the very few surviving Babylonian star names.
bio: Nunki (Sigma Sagittarii) is a hot blue main-sequence star about 230 light-years away, the second-brightest in Sagittarius. It forms part of the 'Teapot' asterism, near where the Milky Way is richest.
cultural: 'Nunki' is one of the rare star names handed down directly from ancient Mesopotamia, recorded by the Babylonians thousands of years ago and preserved through to modern star catalogues.
